nodes.name: Test Builds
nodes.summary: Builds oxiguitar-app, oxiguitar-cli, and plugins for Linux (x86_64, ARM64, X11), Windows (x86_64, ARM64), and macOS (universal) on push to develop. Uploads 14-day artifacts including binaries and test plugins for manual testing by contributors.

nodes.name: CI
nodes.summary: Main CI workflow with 8 parallel checks: formatting (rustfmt), lint (clippy on MSRV and stable, including X11 and individual format readers), multi-platform tests (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, macOS), plugin template verification on all platforms, speed budget tests, license/advisory checks (cargo-deny), no-network isolation test, and DCO sign-off check. A ci-success gate job requires all checks to pass before merging.

nodes.name: Debian
nodes.summary: Weekly and on-change workflow for Debian packaging: audits all Rust crates against Debian sid packages, then builds .deb packages offline in a Docker-based Debian sid container (skipped if sid's rustc is older than the project's MSRV). Runs lintian checks and installs packages into a clean sid for smoke testing.

nodes.name: Manual
nodes.summary: Builds the user manual (docs/manual/) and plugin developer guide (docs/plugins/) as mdBook sites. On PRs, builds and checks for broken links without publishing. On pushes to main, builds and deploys the manual to GitHub Pages at mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar/ and the guide at mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar/plugin-guide/.

nodes.name: Fuzz
nodes.summary: Fuzz testing of all file readers (guitar_pro_3_5, guitar_pro_6, guitar_pro_7, gpif), the .gp writer, and plugin dispatch/tabs using cargo-fuzz on nightly Rust. On PRs runs short 4-minute checks; on manual dispatch runs up to 680 minutes split across two jobs sharing corpus. Targets include any_file format detection and plugin_tab on PRs only.

nodes.name: Interop
nodes.summary: Interoperability testing for .gp file output: writes all fixtures as .gp using oxiguitar-formats' write_gp example, then verifies that alphaTab (a JavaScript Guitar Pro reader) and MuseScore 4 read every file beat-by-beat with matching tracks, bars, and notes. Only runs on PRs touching format crates, fixtures, or interop scripts.

nodes.name: Listening Pack
nodes.summary: On-demand workflow that renders all reference songs (fixtures/reference/*.gp) into WAV files using oxiguitar-cli's SoundFont plugin with every supported sound set: FluidR3 GM, MuseScore General, FreePats electric guitar banks (clean, jazz, direct), and multiple SFZ instruments (Karoryfer guitars/basses, SM Drums, Naked Drums, Big Rusty Drums, MuldjordKit). Each set is a separate artifact kept 14 days for manual listening review.

nodes.name: Release Packages
nodes.summary: Full release pipeline producing .deb, .rpm, AppImage (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Wayland and X11), Windows .zip (x86_64/ARM64), and macOS universal .dmg. Generates third-party license report, builds and smoke-tests each package in its target environment (Debian sid, Fedora, native runner), generates SHA256SUMS, and creates a GitHub draft release on v* tag pushes. Core packages exclude plugins; basic plugins ship separately.

nodes.name: Spikes

nodes.label: FONTLOG.txt
nodes.description: Detailed version history and changelog for the Bravura font, documenting 40+ releases from v0.1 (May 2013) through v1.482 (August 2026). Covers SMuFL compatibility evolution, glyph additions and revisions, stylistic set definitions, and pipeline changes. All versions by Daniel Spreadbury.

nodes.label: OFL.txt

nodes.label: engravingDefaults
nodes.description: 30 engraving default parameters for music notation rendering: barline spacing, beam thickness, stem thickness, slur thickness, staff line thickness, tie thickness, tuplet bracket thickness, text font family (Academico, Century Schoolbook, Edwin, serif), and more.

nodes.label: glyphAdvanceWidths
nodes.description: 3467 glyph advance width values defining the horizontal spacing of each glyph in the Bravura font. Includes Sagittal accidentals, clefs, noteheads, articulations, dynamics, barlines, and all other SMuFL-encoded symbols.

nodes.label: glyphBBoxes
nodes.description: 3434 bounding box definitions (north-east and south-west coordinates) for all glyphs in the Bravura font, used for hit testing, layout, and rendering bounds.

nodes.label: glyphsWithAlternates
nodes.description: 226 entries mapping base glyphs to their stylistic alternate variants, each with codepoint and name. E.g., 4stringTabClef maps to Tall and Serif variants.

nodes.label: glyphsWithAnchors
nodes.description: 643 entries defining stem connection points, cut-out regions, and origin points for glyphs that need precise alignment (e.g., accidentals with cutOutSE/cutOutNW/cutOutSW points, noteheads with noteheadOrigin, dynamics with opticalCenter).

nodes.label: ligatures
nodes.description: 201 ligature definitions combining multiple glyphs into single composed characters. Includes parenthesised accidentals, Johnston accidentals, time signature numerator/denominator combinations, chord symbol ligatures, and dynamics separators.

nodes.label: optionalGlyphs
nodes.description: 528 optional glyph definitions with classes (e.g., clefs, accidentals, noteheads, articulations, dynamics, barlines, time-signatures, chord-symbols, guitar, percussion, keyboard), codepoints, and descriptions. Includes serif/tall variants of clefs, bracketed accidentals, and editorial symbols.

nodes.label: sets (Stylistic Sets)
nodes.description: 9 OpenType stylistic set definitions (ss01 through ss10, excluding ss05 which was removed in v1.481): ss01 (small staff optical size), ss02 (short flags), ss03 (straight flags), ss04 (large outside-staff time signatures), ss06 (light-weight tuplet digits), ss07 (small chord symbol subscript/superscript), ss08 (oversized noteheads and slash noteheads), ss09 (large narrow time signatures), ss10 (figured bass accidentals with longer stems).

nodes.label: ss01 - Small Staff Optical Size
nodes.description: Stylistic set 01: smaller optical size glyphs for small staves, including clefs, time signature digits, noteheads, dynamics, and articulations.

nodes.label: ss02 - Short Flags
nodes.description: Stylistic set 02: short up-stem flags (8th through 1024th) designed to avoid collisions with augmentation dots.

nodes.label: ss03 - Straight Flags
nodes.description: Stylistic set 03: straight (non-curled) flag variants for all note values from 8th to 1024th, both up and down.

nodes.label: ss04 - Large Outside-Staff Time Signatures
nodes.description: Stylistic set 04: large, narrow sans serif time signature digits and symbols for display outside the staff.

nodes.label: ss06 - Light Tuplet Digits
nodes.description: Stylistic set 06: lighter-weight tuplet digits (0-9, colon) and parenthesised/bracketed tuplet markers.

nodes.label: ss07 - Small Chord Symbols
nodes.description: Stylistic set 07: smaller optical size chord symbols for subscript and superscript placement (half-diminished, diminished, augmented, major seventh, minor, and accidentals).

nodes.label: ss08 - Oversized Noteheads
nodes.description: Stylistic set 08: oversized versions of noteheads (double whole, square double whole, whole, half, black) and slash noteheads, merged from removed ss05.

nodes.label: ss09 - Large Narrow Time Signatures
nodes.description: Stylistic set 09: large, narrow bold serif time signature digits and symbols.

nodes.label: ss10 - Figured Bass Accidentals with Longer Stems
nodes.description: Stylistic set 10: figured bass accidentals (double flat, flat, natural, sharp, double sharp, triple flat, triple sharp) with longer ascenders and descenders.

nodes.label: Font Metadata (fontName, fontVersion)
nodes.description: Top-level font identification: fontName='Bravura', fontVersion=1.482. Version 1.482 corrected from originally-released 1.4900 since head.fontRevision cannot represent 4-digit fractions.

nodes.label: ADR 0000 — Template
nodes.description: Template for Architecture Decision Records with sections for Context, Options, Decision, and Consequences.

nodes.label: ADR 0001 — Record decisions in the repository
nodes.description: Establishes the ADR process: every significant decision gets a numbered record in docs/adr/, never rewritten after acceptance, later records supersede earlier ones. References the project brief and ROADMAP.md.

nodes.label: ADR 0002 — Score model, first version
nodes.description: Decides on a tree-based score model (alphaTab-like) with Score > MasterBar > Track > Staff > Bar > Voice > Beat > Note. Defines exact time via Duration with tuplets, grace notes as time-free beats, fretted/pitched notes, bends, and effects. Readers map GP3–5, GPX, GP7/8, MuseScore, and MusicXML onto this model.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 — File readers: write our own, cross-check with guitarpro
nodes.description: Decides to write custom file readers (oxiguitar-formats) instead of adopting or forking the guitarpro crate. Readers are written for untrusted input with bounds-checked reads. guitarpro is kept as a cross-check tool. Plans GPX and GP7/8 readers next.

nodes.label: ADR 0004 — GUI toolkit: Slint
nodes.description: Selects Slint over iced and egui as the GUI toolkit. Scores include palette/docking, keyboard/screen-reader access, text input, API stability, and mobile path. Slint wins on accessibility, i18n, API stability, and mobile. egui is the fallback. References the renderer ADR and UI design doc.

nodes.label: ADR 0005 — Renderer: CPU raster + krilla PDF
nodes.description: Chooses CPU raster rendering via tiny-skia for screen, PNG export, and visual regression tests, with krilla for PDF export. Both backends draw from the same oxiguitar-display list. Bravura music font with Noto Sans text font. Plans tiling for smooth scrolling.

nodes.label: ADR 0006 — No file drops on Wayland
nodes.description: Accepts no file-drop support on Wayland as a permanent gap. winit 0.30 has no Wayland drag-and-drop; Slint 1.18 doesn't forward OS drops. Rejects unsafe workarounds and polling. Users open files via File → Open, double-click in file manager, or command line.

nodes.label: ADR 0007 — No macOS open document events
nodes.description: Accepts no macOS open-document events (Apple Events) as a permanent gap. winit 0.30 has no event for opened documents; Slint 1.18 forwards none. Rejects unsafe NSApplicationDelegate workaround. Users open files via File → Open, dock drops, or command line.

nodes.label: ADR 0008 — Plugin architecture
nodes.description: Introduces a plugin system with native .oxp libraries, one per format/tool/platform. Core keeps model, editing, engraving, player transport, mixer, settings, and plugin host. Plugins for formats, exports, audio, and platform code. Moves plugin system from M5 to M2. Contains multiple amendments from Mateus. References docs/design/plugins.md.

nodes.label: ADR 0009 — Wayland first: Slint pinned to 1.17.1
nodes.description: Enforces Wayland-first policy: pins Slint to 1.17.1 to avoid arboard's X11 dependency in the Wayland build. Slint 1.18 replaced copypasta with arboard which always pulls x11rb. Sets rule that Wayland build gets the clean solution; X11 build gets workarounds. References ADR 0008 for the two-build plan.

Event-stream test fixture for rhythm notation on tablature. Contains a single bar with 4 beats (quarter notes) in 4/4 time at 120 BPM, using standard tuning (EADGBE) on a 6-string guitar with 24 frets. Tests display of rhythmic values on tab staves.

Event-stream test fixture for musical section markers and directions. Defines 10 bars with section labels (Intro, Verse, Chorus, Bridge, Outro) and direction markers (end of section, end of song). Tests section-based navigation and display.

Event-stream test fixture for 7-string guitar. Defines a single bar with 4 quarter-note beats using 7-string tuning (BEGCGBE, MIDI pitches 35-74). Tests extended-range guitar support with an additional low B string.
Event-stream test fixture for slide techniques. Contains a single bar with 4 beats demonstrating hammer-ons, pull-offs, and slides. Tests articulation techniques in event-based notation.

Event-stream test fixture for standard notation only (no tablature). Defines a single bar with 4 quarter-note beats in 4/4 time, using treble clef. Tests rendering of standard music notation without tab staff.

Event-stream test fixture for dual-staff notation with treble and bass clefs. Defines a single bar with 4 beats using both clefs simultaneously. Tests multi-clef system layout for classical guitar or bass guitar.

Event-stream test fixture for strum patterns and guitar techniques. Contains a single bar with 4 beats demonstrating strum notation, palm muting, and other playing techniques. Tests complex articulation in event format.

Event-stream test fixture for system layout with tall notation. Contains 20 bars of dense musical content with multiple voices, testing how the renderer handles system height constraints and automatic shrinking of notation spacing.

Event-stream test fixture for tempo changes throughout a piece. Defines 10 bars with tempo markers starting at 120 BPM and changing to various tempos (100, 80, 140, 60 BPM). Tests tempo automation in event-based format.
Event-stream test fixture for time signature changes. Defines 8 bars with time signatures changing between 4/4, 3/4, 6/8, and 2/4. Tests meter changes in event-based musical notation.
Event-stream test fixture for tremolo picking technique. Defines a single bar with 4 beats using tremolo picking notation. Tests rapid alternate picking articulation in event format.
Event-stream test fixture for triplet rhythms. Contains a single bar with triplet groupings (quarter-note triplets, eighth-note triplets) across 4 beats. Tests tuplet notation in event-based format.

Event-stream test fixture for polyphonic two-voice notation. Defines a single bar with two independent voices (up and down stem directions) playing simultaneously. Tests multi-voice rendering in event format.
Event-stream test fixture for unusual tuplet ratios. Contains a single bar with non-standard tuplet groupings (5-tuplets, 7-tuplets, etc.). Tests extended tuplet support in event-based notation.

Event-stream test fixture for vibrato and trill techniques. Defines a single bar with beats using vibrato (wide and narrow) and trill articulations. Tests expressive technique notation in event format.

Event-stream test fixture for whammy bar and fade-in techniques. Defines a single bar with beats using dive-bomb, whammy bar dips, and fade-in articulations. Tests pitch bend effects in event-based notation.

nodes.summary: Documentation file for Guitar Pro 7.6 reference songs. Explains the purpose of the reference files in this directory — they are test songs used by the oxiguitar test suite to validate parsing, round-tripping, and rendering of Guitar Pro 7.6 (.gp, .gpx) files. Lists available reference songs and their test coverage.

Guitar Pro 7.6 XML format file (GPIF) testing bend techniques. Contains 3 bars, 10 beats, and 9 notes demonstrating various bend types: full bends (100% destination), half bends (50% destination), and release bends. Notes include G4 (fret 8, string 4), D4 (fret 7, string 3), A4 (frets 5 and 10), and E5 (fret 12). Rhythms include quarter, half, and eighth notes. Single guitar track with Electric Guitar sound, standard tuning (EADGBE), 24 frets.

Guitar Pro 7.6 XML format file (GPIF) testing chord naming and multi-note chords. Contains 4 bars, 15 beats, and 23 notes forming chord voicings: Am (5-note chord across all strings), G6 (3-note chord), Fmaj7 (6-note chord), and A (5-note chord). Uses whole, half, quarter, and eighth note rhythms. Single guitar track with Electric Guitar sound, standard tuning (EADGBE), 24 frets. Tests chord display with multiple simultaneous notes per beat.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Drop D tuning with a capo, showing tuning and capo info in the score header. Extracted from a Guitar Pro 7.6 save; contains only the score.xml content.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A dense lick with several musical effects on neighbouring notes displayed in lanes above the tablature, testing how Guitar Pro 7.6 writes combined effects.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Four voices on one staff - voices 1 and 3 with stems up, voices 2 and 4 with stems down, with whole-bar rests hidden. Tests multi-voice notation rendering.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A full header with title, subtitle, artist, album, words, music, copyright, tabber, and tuning fields. Tests header and metadata serialization.

Guitar Pro file created by Mateus in Guitar Pro 7.6: nylon guitar with both high E strings played open. Used to verify Guitar Pro's octave numbering (MIDI note ÷ 12) and how default tunings are written.
Guitar Pro file created by Mateus in Guitar Pro 7.6: six piano tracks with notes spanning MIDI 0 to 127. Used to verify Guitar Pro's handling of out-of-range frets and default tuning assignment.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Repeat signs, a repeat played three times, first and second endings, and a double bar. Tests repeat and ending notation serialization.

Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Rehearsal letters with section names; segno and coda signs at bar starts, with To Coda, Fine and D.S. al Coda directions. Tests section markers and navigation directions.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: A labelled starting tempo followed by tempo changes at bar boundaries and mid-bar. Tests tempo marking serialization at different granularities.
Guitar Pro 7.6 reference file: Quintuplets, sextuplets, septuplets, duplets, and a 5:3 ratio marked with n:m notation. Tests non-standard tuplet serialization.

Documentation explaining the guitar-pro-check fixture directory: files for checking the .gp and .gp5 writers, including test results from Guitar Pro 7.6.0 on Wine/Debian. Documents known interop issues and how to regenerate files.
